description: This file defines an abstract base class 'ActionsPreset' for notification action presets within an Android wearable notifications package. It includes a constructor and an abstract method to apply notification settings.

classes.name: ActionsPreset
classes.description: Abstract class serving as a base for notification actions presets, intended for extension to define specific notification behaviors.

methods.name: ActionsPreset
methods.description: Constructor taking a resource ID for the preset name, calls superclass constructor.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Abstract method to apply notification modifications, including context, notification builder, and wearable options.
